images.title: A cross of five dates
images.purpose: Show a plus shaped cross of five calendar dates whose sum is 5 times the centre.
images.composition: A cross of five cells in the centre with a sum prompt beneath; wide white space.
exact_structure: A cross of exactly 5 equal square cells outlined in #2B2B2B: one cell on top holding "8", a row of three cells in the middle holding "14", "15", "16" left to right, and one cell below holding "22", the "8" directly above "15" and the "22" directly below "15".
The centre cell "15" is filled reddish purple #CC79A7; the other four cells are filled light teal #0072B2.
Below the cross, centred, one line "Sum = ?" with the question mark in reddish purple #CC79A7.
No other calendar cells, no letter a, no answer 75.
rejection: dates other than 8, 14, 15, 16, 22 or in wrong places
the sum 75 or the rule 5a shown
images.takeaway: The cross of five dates is balanced round its centre, so its sum is a multiple of the centre.
images.description: A plus shaped cross of the dates 8, 14, 15, 16 and 22 with the centre 15 highlighted and the prompt Sum = ?.
images.context: Shown beside the cross example text.
images.teaching_notes: Compare the total with the highlighted centre before reading any rule.

image_decisions.why: The highlighted centre keeps attention on the one number the sum is compared with.
